gaps: Physical temperature, scalar thermodynamic pressure, spin polarization and magnetic state remain unverified.

unknown_field_reasons.magnetic_state: No case-insensitive matches for spin, magnet, ferro, polar, or ISPIN in the extracted text. This supports not verified in inspected content; it does not prove every external supplement, image, or underlying calculation input omits magnetic information.
unknown_field_reasons.temperature: Temperature hits concern atomic-feature descriptors or cited publications; numeric-K hits concern feature tabulations/references. No physical temperature assigned to these three Table 2 calculations was verified. Electronic smearing must remain separate.
unknown_field_reasons.pressure: No pressure keyword hit; the verified statement concerns relaxation of non-imposed stress components. Store no exact hydrostatic pressure.
unknown_field_reasons.uncertainty: Reported two-decimal strengths and 0.08 GPa peak convergence serve different roles; neither establishes statistical or total uncertainty.
unknown_field_reasons.raw_protocol: Input files, magnetic tags, exact strain grids, complete pseudopotential identifiers, and material-by-material stress trajectories remain unverified.

protocols.property_interpretation: Reported tensile stress at the first detected structural instability under fixed transverse strain

structure.crystal_structure_normalization_status: Inferred standard bulk silicon structure from the reported two-atom primitive cell and cubic directions; diamond-cubic is not explicitly named in the inspected source text. Preserve this inference label or keep the normalized field null if explicit-only ingestion is required.

state_fields.pressure_note: Anisotropic transverse stresses are allowed by this loading protocol; do not assign exact zero hydrostatic pressure.
state_fields.magnetic_note: Not verified in inspected paper; do not infer a spin setup.
